description: This file defines the 'Root' class for creating Root PPS objects in OLE containers, including methods for saving the container, calculating sizes, and writing headers and data blocks.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Class for creating and saving Root PPS objects for OLE containers, handling block sizes, headers, and data serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Root object with timestamps and child PPS objects, calling parent constructor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entire OLE container to a specified file or stream, including headers, data blocks, and PPS structures.

methods.name: calcSize
methods.description: Calculates size-related parameters for the container, such as number of small and big blocks.

methods.name: adjust2
methods.description: Helper function to compute block size exponent for block size calculation.

methods.name: saveHeader
methods.description: Writes the OLE header information to the file stream.

methods.name: saveBigData
methods.description: Writes large data blocks for PPS objects exceeding small data size.

methods.name: makeSmallData
methods.description: Generates small data stream for PPS objects with small data, and updates the small block depot.

methods.name: savePps
methods.description: Writes the PPS objects' WKs to the file stream.

methods.name: saveBbd
methods.description: Saves the Big Block Depot and related block chain structures.
